In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the heterotic string theory on ALE instantons is a non-trivial deformation of a superconformal field theory, which has been recently shown by Gepner [Gepner 1987] to be a non-linear sigma model on a Calabi-Yau manifold.
ALE gravitational instanton solutions are a new class of solutions to the heterotic string theory which are not related by duality to the known solutions with flat metrics.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heterotic string admits ALE gravitational instanton solutions with gauge instantons embedded in them.
ALE gravitational instantons coupled to gauge instanton backgrounds can be interpreted as a new class of exact string vacua.
the heterotic string theory on an ALE instanton background is dual to the N = (4; 4) supersymmetric σ-model with target space given by the moduli space of the corresponding gauge instantons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the low-energy effective action of the heterotic string admits a rich structure of self-dual gravitational instanton backgrounds coupled to instantons of the internal gauge theory.
the ALE instanton solutions are a new class of supersymmetric backgrounds of the heterotic and type I string.
